subject: Re: req.resume error: Cannot call method 'resume' of null shiny

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: req.resume error: Cannot call method 'resume' of null shiny
parts:
We finally found a solid repro case (it seems to be specific to Red Hat 5/6, and were trying for ages to repro on Ubuntu).

Can you all try installing the latest Shiny Server or Shiny Server Pro?

Shiny Server Open Source 1.4.0.718:
wget https://s3.amazonaws.com/rstudio-shiny-server-os-build/centos5.9/x86_64/shiny-server-1.4.0.718-rh5-x86_64.rpm
sudo yum install --nogpgcheck shiny-server-1.4.0.718-rh5-x86_64.rpm

Shiny Server Pro 1.4.0.637:
wget https://s3.amazonaws.com/rstudio-shiny-server-pro-build/centos5.9/x86_64/shiny-server-commercial-1.4.0.637-rh5-x86_64.rpm
sudo yum install --nogpgcheck shiny-server-commercial-1.4.0.637-rh5-x86_64.rpm

If this does fix the issue please let us know. If this doesn't fix the issue please email j...@rstudio.com and je...@rstudio.com with the contents of your /etc/init.d/shiny-server and /var/log/shiny-server.log files.

Thank you and sorry for the inconvenience!

On Wednesday, July 15, 2015 at 6:26:13 AM UTC-7, Andrew Yip wrote:
I'm seeing such issue too, please keep me updated, and if there's any update/patch would love to have it too.

On Friday, June 5, 2015 at 7:06:24 PM UTC+3, Logan Meltabarger wrote:
Anytime I update an input from the user interface I encounter this error: "req.resume error: Cannot call method 'resume' of null."

It kills the shiny-server process after 4 or 5 occurrences.

Has anyone encountered this error or know where to start the debugging? None of my inputs are ever null because they are given initial values...and I do not call resume() in either my server.R or ui.R.

The logs are of no help.

Thanks,
Logan

messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: req.resume error: Cannot call method 'resume' of null shiny
parts:
All,

So sorry for the headaches this has surely caused. We think we’ve finally gotten a handle on the primary cause of the crashing issue. Can you try upgrading to the latest version of Shiny Server?

Shiny Server Open Source v1.4.0.718: https://www.rstudio.com/products/shiny/download-server/
Shiny Server Pro users can download from the link they initially received and are looking for build 1.4.0.637 which is now on that page.

You will probably see instances of the log entry “req.resume error: Cannot call method 'resume' of null” in your /var/log/shiny-server.log file. These can be safely ignored, and will be squelched in a future release.

If you see any crashes under these latest versions, please let us know! Thank you for your patience, and our sincerest apologies for the inconvenience!

Best,
Jeff
